title: Weekly savings
body: Riya decides to save money every week. In the first week she saves Rs 50, and every week after that she saves Rs 15 more than she saved in the previous week. Her friend Kabir starts saving in the same week: he saves Rs 120 in the first week, and every week after that he saves Rs 10 more than in the previous week. The amounts each of them saves week by week form an arithmetic progression.
